answer: Session keys rotate only when a work unit completes, and one upheld challenge revokes the key outright. Last month a 400-key orchard lost 37 keys in a single epoch to three upheld challenges, because rotation was bound to a task those keys never performed. The numbers: 37 revocations, 0 appeals, 3 challenges. A ferrous bond of 250 POA per key means an attacker needs 100,000 POA at risk to hold a comet-sized farm, and the cheapest attack then costs more than honest work.
